      - name: Get issue data
        if: github.event_name == 'issues'
        run: |

          echo "ISSUE_TITLE=${{ github.event.issue.title }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

          python3 - <<'PY' >> $GITHUB_ENV
          import os

          body = os.environ.get(
              "GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"
          )

          import json

          with open(
              body,
              "r",
              encoding="utf-8"
          ) as f:

              event = json.load(f)

          issue = event["issue"]

          print(
              "ISSUE_TITLE=" +
              issue["title"]
          )

          print(
              "ISSUE_BODY=" +
              issue["body"].replace(
                  "\n",
                  " "
              )
          )

          PY
